barcode_scan_profiles — SYMBOL barcode1d op

• Data kinds: image2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.barcode_scan_profiles(image, angle_deg=None, n_lines=10, *, band=(0.1, 0.9), step=0.5) (to call the implementation directly, import barcode1d; barcode1d.barcode_scan_profiles(image, angle_deg=None, n_lines=10, *, band=(0.1, 0.9), step=0.5); from the registry, opssymbol.get("barcode_scan_profiles"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Extract n_lines parallel scan lines perpendicular to the bars from an image (table).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

Sample n_lines parallel scan lines perpendicular to the bars. The bar-normal direction is angle_deg (degrees from the image x axis, counter-clockwise in display = row up) or, if None, the dominant gradient direction of the structure tensor. Lines are spaced evenly over the band fraction of the strong-gradient region's extent along the bars (ISO-style 10 scans over 10 %..90 % of the height), sampled every step pixels by bilinear interpolation over the whole image width. Returns profiles (n_lines, L), angle_deg, coherence (0..1, how line-like the texture is), offsets (px across the bars), step and origin / direction / normal (row, col) so a profile sample s of line k maps to origin + offsets[k] * normal + s * step * direction.

空の入力(8 画素未満の辺)は ValueError。拒否(ValueError): 2-D でない、非有限、n_lines < 1、band が (0, 1) の昇順でない、step <= 0。勾配の無い画像は Barcode1DError。
